description: ASR RemoveProtectionContainerMapping `providerSpecificInput` is polymorphic on instanceType, but the spec declares no subtype of `ReplicationProviderContainerUnmappingInput`, so the converted model keeps only `instanceType` and S.Struct strips every other field on encode. Retype it as an untyped document.
